Summary: Online payments declined for Amex cards
Description: Amex cards declined at checkout from 08:50 CLT. Gateway rejected the new 3DS payload. Restored 4.8.2.

Summary: Booking page down after 4.9.0 deploy
Description: Booking page returned 502 from 15:40 CLT to 18:55 CLT. Rolled back to 4.8.4, fixed forward in 4.9.1.

Summary: Receipts are emailed twice after a refund
Description: Every refund since 4.10.1 sends the receipt twice.

Summary: Print invoices on A5 paper
Description: Front desk printers at three clinics only take A5.

Summary: SMS reminders are not sent on public holidays
Description: The reminder job skipped every clinic on 18 and 19 September.

Summary: Export the day's schedule to CSV
Description: Who: receptionists. What: export one day's appointments as CSV from Reporting. Why: clinics print the day's list. Acceptance criteria: one row per appointment; columns date, start time, end time, patient name, treatment, room; UTF-8 with BOM so Excel shows accents. Demo: export Tuesday at Providencia and open it in Excel.

Summary: Patients can reschedule from the reminder SMS link
Description: Reminder SMS link opens a reschedule page with the next free slots for the same practitioner.

Summary: Upgrade the SMS provider SDK to v5
Description: v4 is end of support in January.

Summary: Double booking when two receptionists save the same slot
Description: Two receptionists saving the same slot at the same moment both succeed. Seen at Providencia and Ñuñoa.

Summary: Patients join a waitlist for a fully booked day
Description: Who: patients. What: join a waitlist for a full day and get an SMS when a slot frees up. Acceptance criteria: phone required, email optional; one waitlist entry per patient per day.

Summary: Rotate the SMTP relay credentials
Description: Annual rotation of the relay password. New secret in the vault; config change ships with 4.11.4.

Summary: Appointment reminders use the clinic's time zone
Description: Reminder SMS showed the appointment time in UTC (12:30 for a 9:30 appointment). Fixed by formatting in the clinic's time zone; ships in 4.12.0.

Summary: Receptionists see a patient's outstanding balance when booking
Description: Show the unpaid balance on the booking screen.

Summary: Calendar week view overlaps on small laptops
Description: Under 1366 px wide the week view columns overlap.

Summary: Remove the legacy v1 booking endpoint
Description: No client has called /api/v1/bookings since August.

Summary: Patients can cancel an appointment from Safari on iPhone
Description: Cancel button on My appointments does nothing in Safari on iOS 18.1. Chrome works. Suspect the confirm dialog.

Summary: Same appointment slot can be booked twice
Description: A patient called because her 16:00 slot was given to someone else too.

Summary: Add a practitioner filter to the calendar
Description: Receptionists want to show only one practitioner's column in the day view.

Summary: Push notification opens the wrong appointment
Description: Tapping the reminder push opens the next appointment, not the one in the message.

Summary: Can we take deposits from patients who often miss appointments?
Description: Question: can the payment provider hold a deposit and release it on attendance? Time box: 2 days. Decision it feeds: whether the no-show deposit policy can launch in Q1.
